title: Filters and Formatting
description: Hand lines to sort, rewrap prose with gq and gw, and let = fix the indentation.

intro: Three operators reshape lines instead of editing them. ! sends lines through a shell command and puts back what it prints, so sort, column or jq can do the work. gq rewraps text to 'textwidth', and = fixes the indentation.
They take motions and text objects like any operator, and doubling one works on the current line: !!, gqq and ==.

commands.text: Filter lines through a command: !ip, then sort and <CR>, sorts a paragraph.
Filter from the cursor's line to the end of the file.
Filter the current line, or with a count, that many lines.
Rewrap the current line at 'textwidth'. A comment keeps its leader on every line.
Rewrap the lines a motion covers: gqip rewraps a paragraph.
Rewrap like gq, then put the cursor back on the same text.
Fix the indentation of the current line.
Fix the indentation of everything inside a pair of braces.
Reindent the whole file: go to the top, then = to the bottom.
All three are operators, so each takes the shortest motion that covers the lines you want.
